findings.finding: The 'pointed arch' reads as a flat lintel with stepped/chamfered corners at 1x; the Gothic point is not legible.
findings.fix: Raise the centre 2px of the inner frame head by 1-2px and step the shoulders 1px per row so the opening apex forms a visible point; keep the 1px dark outline following the new curve.

findings.finding: Red runner is a straight vertical stripe of almost uniform red; it does not fold over each nosing, so on the lower steps it flattens the tread/riser rhythm.
findings.fix: On each tread row lighten the runner by one palette step (tread top) and darken it one step on the riser row below, so the runner alternates light/dark with the stone steps.

findings.finding: The three-sided light rail cap plus dark inner line reads a little like a raised picture-frame rim rather than low rails standing on the floor; the 1px floor shadow is faint against the dark flagstones.
findings.fix: Darken the rail's outer 1px floor-shadow on the east and south-facing side one more step, and break the rail cap with 1px darker joints every ~6px so it reads as rail sections rather than a continuous frame.

findings.finding: The two lowest oak steps are tall flat brown blocks with a single dark top line; at 1x they lean toward reading as stacked crates/drawers rather than steps.
findings.fix: Add a 1px light nosing highlight along the top of each lower tread and drop the riser one shade darker so tread/riser contrast matches the upper steps; add 1-2 grain pixels on treads only.

findings.finding: Oak side rails are the same hue/value as the oak steps and the adjacent oak bookcases, so the lower half merges into one brown mass and at 1x can read like a cabinet in the doorway.
findings.fix: Shade the side rails one step darker than the treads and give each rail a 1px light top cap; leave a 1px dark gap between rail and tread edge.

findings.finding: Mid-grey stone treads and mid-dark risers are close in value on the middle steps and the straw/dropping speckle adds noise, weakening the step rhythm.
findings.fix: Push the riser one palette step darker on the middle two steps and keep speckle pixels on tread tops only (max 2-3 per tread).

findings.finding: Wooden rails rise slightly above the hole's north edge and read close to a raised frame; the feather is small but legible.
findings.fix: Trim the north rail to a 2px cap aligned to the drop line and add a 1px floor shadow under it, matching the castle variant.

places.finding: Clock tower: stair now sits cleanly in the north wall at the west end; frame top ends just below the cornice without cutting it. Honeydukes: light stone arch between the bookcases reads as a separate doorway; the merged oak lower half is the only weak point (see piece). Owlery: down stairwell beside the west wall reads as descending, entry cell clear.
places.fix: No placement change needed; apply the piece-level rail/riser shading fixes.
